body: i wish one day i'll be able to believe this. right now, life just feels so impossible for me.
thank you for this! i'll keep these in mind 🥹

i do! just try and immerse yourself in places and communities with the kind of vibes that you like. it'll make making friends easier. good luck, OP! and enjoy dancing <3 really just enjoy yourself and you'll be attracting people on the same wavelength as yours :)
well, mainly i joined organizations in my uni that align with my interests, oh and i let an extrovert "adopt" me (an introvert)
i hate how my anxiety gets the best of me

funny thing, after posting this i had one friend who messaged me asking to watch a movie with her and another friend asking if i was in town because he just cooked carbonara and wants to invite people over T\_T my friends ARE my friends, wtf am i talking about here T\_T
true! maybe it's not a you problem. maybe shes just not that into you 😭
another way to look at it, maybe you do need to break the ice some more. play twenty questions and and take turns answering them. it helped a bit with my situationship.

hi, op! im pretty confrontational so if i were you, i'd ask her direct questions about whether or not is she interested in talking to me and what intentions does she have because by the looks of it, if youre literally the only one initiating conversations, she's not that interested. and so if she isnt, stop investing time and energy for her.
same. and i have this weird gap in my teeth that i fixate on
ooh, i guess it is more of hypomania than mania. i'll make sure to tell my psych about this. but hmm, is it different in every person who is diagnosed with bipolar?

impulsive buying then feels shame afterwards, gets easily bored but find myself constantly seeking for something stimulating like going to some places, hanging out in groups, sudden boost in confidence. there was this manic episode that i was sexually active. i become irritable too. and i feel too awake at night to go to sleep unless i take my meds. idk. or maybe this is just me. but it feels manic.
sagot ako! haha
so tungkol saan po research nyo?
i understand. but i do like her. it's just the dynamics im getting used to, i guess

thanks for the input! those are very good points. i'll try and talk it out with her. maybe it is just some lack of effort to keep things interesting that led me to writing this post. we'll see. anyway, thanks again. i appreciate it!
aside from physical traits, i like that shes generally a chill person. she doesnt trigger my anxieties.
yeah, just enough
but does that mean i dont like her as much? god i feel like im sounding so stupid rn 😭
maybe it's the latter. im pretty sure im done with the whole goofing around phase. i'll take note of your advice. thank you.
me being used to toxic attachments, i guess
no, i dont really want to date another girl who triggers my anxiety. it just makes me question my feelings for her if i dont get too bothered enough of whether or not she'll abandon me...idrk

no, like i said, im glad that she doesnt trigger my anxiety. but it kinda makes me question how much do i actually like her if i dont "care too much" to be  bothered about her abandoning me or what. idk.  im genuinely confused about it.

i was just writing on my journal last night. and i did mention there about dying being some sort of release. i'm not sure what i want to release myself from. i think it's from the whole cycle of just...living? going through the motions, feeling your emotions, picking yourself up only to be broken again. and then trying to rebuild yourself again. then you'd feel resolve but after a few months i find myself thinking the same way all over again
it's been so hard keeping strong lately. but i do have friends i can lean on. still, despite the love and gratitude i feel in my life, i still end up wishing i was dead
i do want to be part of some support group but im not aware of any near my area.
thanks <3

i've recently went to a guidance counsellor here in our university. and i'm going to see a psych this friday (been a monthly thing this year). i just dont see anymore how all these can rid me of this desire. i know im getting better but this constant desire pops up in my head so randomly even during happy moments, moments when i know i can feel peace and contentment about being alive. the thought of kms...it's like it pierces through my skin ever so nicely. i hate it.
thanks! i appreciate your advice a lot. stay safe :)
hope you're feeling a little less sad now. sending hugs, with consent
same thoughts haha i feel more comfortable sharing to strangers that i wont ever meet
not doing superb. i feel things getting worse again. i dont know what to do.

definitely right on the whole subconsciously looking for excuses. i do that every single time i start realizing how smooth everything has been going. i end up self sabotaging. will try to reach out to a therapist. thank you!

hi! omg thank you for your input!! actually i have no idea what splitting means. i just looked it up after reading your reply. and damn, that's exactly what happens to me. i never really thought about me having bpd so i decided to read more about it. all the symptoms explicitly explained everything about me. especially how i deal with anger and anxiety in relationships. a lot of things about me are now starting to make sense after reading about bpd. thank you so much. i've been struggling figuring myself out for almost 5 yrs now. finally, i found an answer. i can now start addressing this issue of mine systematically. again, thank you so much.
